the use of U Net with ResNet connection for semantic segmentation of high water turbidity areas can achieve an accuracy of 97% with 1.6% IoU and the use of GAN to refine the segmentation results of U Net can achieve an accuracy 99% with 1,8% IoU.
we have successfully applied the U Net architecture with residual connection and GAN to segment high water turbidity areas in the coastal areas using Landsat 7 and Landsat 8 satellite images.
the proposed model is able to achieve a high segmentation accuracy of 0.96 and a low loss value of 0.02.

two aspects.
the application of semantic segmentation and semantic segmentation refinement using machine learning to predict water turbidity.

the following: 1) the implementation of U Net architecture with the ResNet connection for water turbidity image segmentation; 2) the implementation of GAN to refine segmentation results; and 3) the comparison of segmentation performance between U Net and U Net with ResNet connection.

the results of this study show that the proposed model can be used as an alternative method for predicting high turbidity areas in the coastal area, which can be used to support water quality monitoring activities in coastal areas.
